cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: Its scientific name is "Oddium Wanderus." At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.description: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.description: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.description: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.description: It has evolved to be suitable for an aquatic life. It can invisibly melt away into water.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.description: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

cards.name: Regice
cards.description: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.description: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

cards.name: Unown
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.description: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

cards.name: Golett
cards.description: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It's been active for thousands of years.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.description: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.description: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.description: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.description: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.description: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.description: It converses with others by magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.description: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.description: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.description: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.description: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.description: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.description: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.description: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.description: It's covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.description: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.description: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.description: It attacks with retractable horns. It throws a punch that's the equivalent of the force of a hundred pro boxers.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. It is capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.description: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.description: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.description: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.
